Mammaṭa
(1050-1100 A. D.); q. in Alaṅkārasudhānidhi, [Page-265a] attributed to Sāyaṇa. See ABORI, Golden Jubilee Vol.. XLVIII an. XLIX. p. 276. See The dual authorship of the Kāvyaprakāśa by H. R. Divekar, JRAS (1927) 505-20. Bhīmasena (Peters. I. p.. 26. 94) reports that he was a son of Jaiyaṭa an. brother of Kaiyaṭa an. Uvaṭa.
-Kāvyaprakāśa. See under the text.
